name: Seeed Wio Tracker L1 Pro
facts: Screen, GPS, built-in battery, and a case. Comes with MeshCore on it, so there is nothing to flash.

name: Seeed SenseCAP T1000-E
facts: Card-sized, with GPS and a built-in battery. No screen. The store page says Meshtastic, but MeshCore runs on it too. You flash MeshCore on it yourself.

name: Heltec V4 (WiFi LoRa 32 V4)
facts: A bare board with an antenna. Pick the 902-928 MHz option. It needs a battery and a case. No GPS. You flash MeshCore on it yourself.

name: Seeed SenseCAP Solar Node P1-Pro
facts: A 5 W solar panel, batteries, antenna, and GPS in one box. Comes with MeshCore repeater software on it.
